```{r setup}
library(ggplot2)
run <- oaireport::load_results()$default
colours <- oaireport::brief_colours
assumption <- function(key) oaireport::run_assumption(run, key)
num <- function(x, digits = 2) oaireport::fmt_num(x, digits, minus = FALSE)
count <- oaireport::fmt_count
pct <- function(x) oaireport::fmt_pct(x, minus = FALSE)
wave <- function(x) sprintf("%02d", as.integer(x))
one <- oaireport::one_row
share <- run$walking_share; share$visit <- wave(share$visit)
pb <- run$cadence_bands_person; pb$visit <- wave(pb$visit)
acc <- run$pro_accuracy
rho <- run$pro_spearman
dflow <- run$device_flow; dflow$wave <- wave(dflow$wave)
cads <- unlist(assumption("reference.step_cadences"))
low <- paste0("steps_", min(cads))
mv_cut <- count(assumption("device.mv_cutpoint"))
min_days <- assumption("reference.min_bout_days_per_week")

sh <- function(measure, cadence = 40) one(share, visit = "06", cadence_ge = cadence, measure = measure)$pooled
band_mean <- function(band, measure) one(pb, visit = "06", band = band, measure = measure)$mean
MEAN <- "mean of valid waves"; EITHER <- "either valid wave"
a <- function(pro, family, rule = "bout_days", device = NULL) {
  rows <- acc[acc$pro == pro & acc$definition == paste0(family, ":", rule), ]
  if (is.null(device)) device <- if (MEAN %in% rows$device) MEAN else unique(rows$device)
  one(rows, device = device)
}
sp <- function(pro, family, rule = "bout_days", device = NULL) num(a(pro, family, rule, device)$specificity)
se <- function(pro, family, rule = "bout_days", device = NULL) num(a(pro, family, rule, device)$sensitivity)
range_sp <- function(pros, families, rule = "bout_days", device = NULL) {
  x <- unlist(lapply(pros, function(p) vapply(families, function(f) a(p, f, rule, device)$specificity, 0)))
  paste0(num(min(x)), "–", num(max(x)))
}
families <- c("counts_mv", paste0("steps_", cads))
pase_any <- c("pase06_any", "pase08_any", "pase10_any")
pase_freq <- c("pase06_frequent", "pase08_frequent", "pase10_frequent")
```

Per-minute step counts for the 48- and 72-month accelerometry weeks (prepared by the Northwestern accelerometry group) match the public minute files. `r count(one(dflow, wave = "06")$valid_with_step_measures)` and `r count(one(dflow, wave = "08")$valid_with_step_measures)` participants with valid wear have steps; the 72-month steps are new.

**MV** (moderate-to-vigorous activity): a minute with at least `r mv_cut` activity counts, the release's cut-point.

# How much of the activity counts is walking

```{r fig-bands, fig.height = 4.2, fig.cap = paste0("Mean share of each participant's wear minutes and activity counts by steps a minute. Grey lines: middle 50% of participants. Labels: mean share of a band's minutes that are MV (≥ ", mv_cut, " counts a minute).")}
b <- pb
b$band <- factor(b$band, levels = unique(b$band))
b$wave <- factor(ifelse(b$visit == "06", "48 months", "72 months"), levels = c("48 months", "72 months"))
bars <- b[b$measure %in% c("share_of_minutes", "share_of_counts"), ]
bars$what <- factor(ifelse(bars$measure == "share_of_minutes", "Wear minutes", "Activity counts"),
                    levels = c("Wear minutes", "Activity counts"))
mv <- b[b$measure == "share_minutes_mv", ]
top <- aggregate(q3 ~ band + wave, data = bars, FUN = max)
mv <- merge(mv, setNames(top, c("band", "wave", "top")), by = c("band", "wave"))
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.75)
ggplot(bars, aes(band, mean, fill = what)) +
  geom_col(position = dodge, width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = q1, ymax = q3), position = dodge, width = 0.3, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_text(data = mv, aes(band, top + 0.06, label = paste0(round(100 * mean), "% MV")),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.2, colour = colours[["label"]]) +
  facet_wrap(~wave, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(colours[["muted"]], colours[["navy"]]), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round(100 * x), "%"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = "Steps a minute", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0))
```

- **Most activity counts are not walking.** The largest share of a participant's counts comes from minutes with 1–19 steps (mean `r pct(band_mean("1-19", "share_of_counts"))` at 48 months).
- **Most MV is walking.** At 40 or more steps a minute, `r pct(sh("mv_minutes_walking"))` of MV minutes are walking minutes.
- **Most walking is not MV.** Only `r pct(band_mean("60-79", "share_minutes_mv"))` of minutes at 60–79 steps a minute are MV.

# Device walkers

A **device walker** is defined by a bout type and a frequency rule, none of them a published standard for walking. **Bout:** 10 or more minutes, 8 of every 10 at or above `r mv_cut` counts a minute (an MV bout) or `r paste(cads, collapse = ", ")` steps a minute (a step bout; 100 is roughly moderate intensity). **Frequency:** a bout on at least 1 or 2 days a week, or at least `r count(assumption("reference.min_bout_minutes_per_week"))` bout minutes a week.

```{r accuracy-helpers}
rule_labels <- c(any_bout = "≥ 1 day/wk", bout_days = "≥ 2 days/wk", bout_minutes = "≥ 150 min/wk")
bout_labels <- c(counts_mv = "MV bouts", setNames(paste0("Steps ≥ ", cads), paste0("steps_", cads)))
as_long <- function(rows, colour) {
  rows$rule <- factor(rule_labels[sub(".*:", "", rows$definition)], levels = rule_labels)
  rows$bout <- factor(bout_labels[rows$family], levels = rev(bout_labels))
  rows$colour <- colour
  rbind(data.frame(rows[c("rule", "bout", "colour")], stat = "Sensitivity", est = rows$sensitivity, lo = rows$sensitivity_lo, hi = rows$sensitivity_hi),
        data.frame(rows[c("rule", "bout", "colour")], stat = "Specificity", est = rows$specificity, lo = rows$specificity_lo, hi = rows$specificity_hi))
}
accuracy_plot <- function(long, values, cols) {
  ggplot(long, aes(est, bout, colour = colour)) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5) +
    facet_grid(as.formula(paste("rule ~", cols)), scales = "free_x") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = values, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 3)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10.5) +
    theme(legend.position = "top", legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4),
          panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines"), strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0))
}
span <- function(x) paste0(num(min(x)), "–", num(max(x)))
item <- acc[acc$pro == "item96", ]
pase <- acc[grepl("^pase", acc$pro), ]
pase$coding <- ifelse(grepl("_any$", pase$pro), "Any walking", "3+ days")
pase$visit <- c("06" = "48 mo", "08" = "72 mo", "10" = "96 mo")[substr(pase$pro, 5, 6)]
```

# The 96-month Walking Question

```{r fig-item, fig.height = 3.6, fig.cap = paste0("Walking Question (walked for exercise since age 50, asked at 96 months): sensitivity and specificity (95% CI) against each device definition of a walker, with device measures averaged over both device weeks or met in either week (the same for ≥ 1 day/wk: a bout in either week). MV: ≥ ", mv_cut, " counts a minute (moderate-to-vigorous).")}
item$week <- factor(ifelse(item$device == EITHER, "Either week", "Mean of both weeks"), levels = c("Mean of both weeks", "Either week"))
long <- as_long(item, item$week)
long$colour <- factor(long$colour, levels = c("Mean of both weeks", "Either week"))
accuracy_plot(long, c(colours[["navy"]], colours[["pase"]]), "stat")
```

Sensitivity is high (`r span(item$sensitivity)`) and specificity low (`r span(item$specificity)`) under every definition: most participants with little device walking still answer yes. No bout type or frequency rule changes this much; the loosest rules (any bout, either week) raise specificity only slightly.

# PASE walking (48, 72 and 96 months)

```{r fig-pase, fig.height = 4.0, fig.cap = paste0("PASE item 2 (walked outside the home in the past week, on any day or on 3+ days): sensitivity and specificity (95% CI) against each device definition of a walker. 48- and 72-month PASE is compared with that visit's device week, 96-month PASE with the mean of both weeks. MV: ≥ ", mv_cut, " counts a minute (moderate-to-vigorous).")}
p <- pase[pase$device != EITHER, ]
long <- as_long(p, p$visit)
long$coding <- factor(rep(p$coding, 2), levels = c("Any walking", "3+ days"))
long$stat <- factor(paste(long$coding, long$stat, sep = "\n"),
                    levels = c("Any walking\nSensitivity", "Any walking\nSpecificity", "3+ days\nSensitivity", "3+ days\nSpecificity"))
accuracy_plot(long, c("#9fb6cf", colours[["item"]], colours[["navy"]]), "stat")
```

```{r pase-ranges}
pa <- p[p$coding == "Any walking", ]; pf <- p[p$coding == "3+ days", ]
```

"Any walking" looks like the Walking Question (sensitivity `r span(pa$sensitivity)`, specificity `r span(pa$specificity)`). Walking on 3+ days trades sensitivity (`r span(pf$sensitivity)`) for specificity (`r span(pf$specificity)`). Results are similar at all three visits.
